A Forthcoming Book by Ray Upchurch

The 10 Commandments of Fatherhood

A Message of Redemption, Hope & Love

A memoir-driven guide to becoming the kind of father whose children feel safe, seen, heard, loved, and prepared.

Book Release · Fall 2026

Join the Book Launch List

About the Book

This is not a book about perfection. It is a book about becoming.

Drawing from Ray’s childhood, his experience raising two sons, the lessons of divorce and rebuilding, and the stories encountered through Daddy Hunger, the book offers ten principles for healing, responsibility, connection, and legacy.

Ray grew up without knowing his father. He built an award-winning documentary, raised two sons through divorce and financial collapse, and spent two decades listening to fathers and children tell him the same story of absence and longing.

The 10 Commandments of Fatherhood is what he learned: ten hard-won principles for becoming a father whose children never have to recover from him.

◆
“The greatest gift you will ever give your child is the father you are still becoming.”
◆
